summary: Adds a --default option to `dotenv get` so a missing or valueless key prints the default and exits 0. Keys set to an empty string still print empty. Includes tests.
narrative: The owner asked for a --default option on `dotenv get` in a single conversation. The default applies when a key is missing or has no value, and it must exit 0 instead of failing. Keys set to an empty string count as having a value and still print empty. Tests were requested too. The conversation was only seconds old at review time and recorded no observations, so there is no evidence of implementation, a PR or a release yet.

milestones.text: Owner asked for a `--default` option on `dotenv get`, with tests, where empty-string values still count as set.

preferences.preference: Include tests with every code change.
